decisions.reason: The landing-page-wide spacing adjustment does not change the section's position, sequential presentation, or listed steps; recording it here would duplicate the visual-system state.
The source changes general section spacing but does not change breakpoint guidance or responsive behavior.
Opening the spacing between sections does not change which copy is included or how landing-page content is distributed.
The source does not change the sign-up action, button control, or access behavior.
The adjustment is specific to spacing between landing-page sections and does not necessarily alter the visual foundation, theme, or shared chrome of follow-on pages.
The dashboard-access paragraph is an administrative plan for future review, while the actual design change concerns only landing-page section spacing.
The source establishes neither a responsive rule nor a cross-page propagation of the spacing adjustment.
Landing-page section spacing is unrelated to the provisioning wizard's visual specification, orientations, or unresolved design values.
The source does not affect the Cognito sign-in page's Actia branding requirement.
A local adjustment to landing-page section spacing does not revise the requested spacing scale or any other design-system handoff specification.
The source does not change footer sharing, footer content, or the placement of site-navigation links.
The visual spacing adjustment does not change the plain-HTML, Tailwind CSS, or no-Astro implementation choices.
